long_biography.plain_text:
Washing cars for 25 cents an hour at his father’s Ford dealership gave Bob Giles an unusually early view of every department in the business. After earning an accounting degree at Texas A&M, he returned as a salesman and sales manager. At 26, he approached Volkswagen for a franchise, bought property in Lafayette and opened a Volkswagen, Porsche and Audi dealership in 1982.

Giles built the business through expansion, consolidation and renewed acquisition, at one point operating more than fifteen dealerships before concentrating the portfolio. He remains chairman and chief executive of Giles Automotive as the group expands across several states. Dealer-association leadership and community programmes also contributed to his selection as the 2022 TIME Dealer of the Year.
